title: DialogueTree
description: Defines a branching dialogue tree for an NPC interaction (M20). TEACHING NOTE — A dialogue tree is a directed graph of conversation nodes. Each node is one exchange. The DialogueBaker validates all node cross-references before the runtime DialogueSystem ever loads the data.

version.description: SemVer version of this dialogue tree.

id.description: Asset identifier matching the DialogueComponent::dialogueTreeID GUID or symbolic name.

nodes.description: All nodes in the tree. Node with id=0 is the required entry point.

id.description: Unique node ID. 0 = root / entry point.

speakerName.description: Display name of the speaker shown in the dialogue HUD.

text.description: The line of dialogue the speaker says.

choices.description: Optional player-choice branches. If non-empty, the player picks one to advance.

nextNodeID.description: TEACHING NOTE — Auto-advance: when choices is empty and isTerminal is false, DialogueSystem.AdvanceDialogue() moves to nextNodeID automatically.

isTerminal.description: True = this node ends the conversation. DialogueSystem publishes DialogueEvent::CLOSED.

label.description: Short text shown to the player in the choice menu.

targetNodeID.description: Node ID to jump to when this choice is selected.
